skill.name: wechat-management
skill.description: Guide AI assistants to draft and send WeChat messages through WeChatMCP with recipient checks, short replies, and sensitive-content confirmation.
skill.summary: Draft and send WeChat messages through WeChatMCP with safety checks and style guidance.
skill.author: 7Sageer, Claude

security_audit.summary: The static command-execution, URL, and entropy alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, an example link, and Chinese text. A medium semantic risk remains because message sending is paired with historical style imitation. This can enable impersonation without explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: Style mimicry can look like impersonation in a messaging workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require the assistant to disclose that it is drafting as the user, avoid imitating another person, and obtain explicit approval before sending.

remediation.issue: Example messages include a hardcoded shortened external link.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the shortened URL with a neutral placeholder so users do not send an unintended promotional link.

semantic_findings.title: Potential Impersonation Through Message Style Mimicry
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the assistant to imitate historical message style before sending WeChat replies. This can support deceptive impersonation unless the user explicitly approves the recipient and final text.

content.value_statement: WeChat replies can be risky when recipients, tone, or sensitive details are unclear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use WeChatMCP with checks before sending.
actual_capabilities: Guides assistants to use the WeChatMCP server before WeChat actions.
Uses screenshots to inspect the current WeChat state before acting.
Drafts short WeChat replies and splits complex replies into multiple messages.
Adapts tone for familiar contacts, work groups, and unfamiliar contacts.
Requires confirmation before sending messages, especially sensitive or financial content.
Asks for web verification when current information is uncertain.
limitations: Requires a working WeChatMCP server and connected WeChat session.
Does not provide account login, contact import, or independent WeChat access.
Should not inspect public accounts or non-chat content.
Needs user confirmation when tool output is unclear or a send action is sensitive.

use_cases.title: Personal Message Drafting
use_cases.description: Draft concise replies for friends while confirming the recipient and final content before sending.

use_cases.title: Work Group Responses
use_cases.description: Prepare professional group replies with fewer emojis and clearer wording for workplace chats.

use_cases.title: Current Topic Verification
use_cases.description: Check current or uncertain information before drafting a reply that references news, products, or terms.

prompt_templates.title: Draft A Short Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Use WeChatMCP to review the current chat. Draft a short reply, then ask me to confirm before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Reply To A Work Group
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the active WeChat group and draft a concise professional response. Avoid casual emojis unless the group tone clearly uses them.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Before Replying
prompt_templates.prompt: Before drafting my WeChat reply, verify any current facts with web search. Show the proposed message and wait for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Sensitive Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a WeChat reply about the sensitive details I provide. Confirm the recipient, summarize the risk, and request explicit approval before sending.

output_examples.input: Ask my project group whether the meeting moved to 3 PM.
output_examples.output: Draft message: Has today's meeting moved to 3 PM? Please confirm the target group before I send it.

output_examples.input: Reply to a friend who asked for a show recommendation.
output_examples.output: Draft message: I found an interesting show. It mixes mythology with science fiction. Want me to send the link?

output_examples.input: Send bank account details to the vendor.
output_examples.output: This includes sensitive financial information. Please confirm the vendor chat and the exact details before any message is sent.

best_practices: Confirm the active chat and recipient before drafting any send action.
Keep messages short and split complex replies into two or three messages.
Use web verification for current facts, then ask for approval before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not send messages without showing the final text to the user first.
Do not inspect public accounts or unrelated non-chat content.
Do not imitate another person or hide that the user approved the message.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the WeChatMCP server and an available WeChat session controlled by the user.

faq.question: Can it send messages by itself?
faq.answer: It guides message sending through WeChatMCP, but it should ask for user confirmation before sending.

faq.question: Does it read all WeChat content?
faq.answer: No. The skill says not to inspect public accounts or non-chat content.

faq.question: How does it handle sensitive information?
faq.answer: It requires a second confirmation for sensitive or financial information before any message is sent.

faq.question: Does it support current information?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the assistant to verify uncertain current information with web search before replying.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this report?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
